description: Add 'Ver respuestas' detail modal to UsuarioTab in ReportsClient.tsx, and add a 'Exportar documento completo' button to GrupoTab that fetches all responses per session. Also wire staffToken prop through AdminClient -> ReportsClient.
steps: Extract the SessionDetailModal into a new file web/components/SessionDetailModal.tsx (to avoid making ReportsClient too large). The modal receives: session: SessionSummary, onClose: () => void, staffToken: string | null. Inside the modal: fetch GET /api/sessions/{session.id}/responses with header x-staff-token=staffToken (if set) when it mounts. Show loading state ('Cargando respuestas...') then render table.

In SessionDetailModal.tsx: At module level (outside component), build a combined question bank lookup: type QuestionInfo = { text: string; dimension: string }. Build Map<string, Map<number, QuestionInfo>> keyed by methodId. Import METHODS from '@/lib/methods/registry' (pure data, no server deps). For each method, iterate method.questions and populate the inner map. Build a scale label lookup: Map<string, Map<number, string>> keyed by methodId. For each method, iterate method.scale.options and populate inner map.

In SessionDetailModal.tsx: Modal content: (1) Header with student name, email, phone, cohort, method label, dominant code, date. (2) Table with columns: Nº | Pregunta (text from question bank, or 'Pregunta #{id}' if not found) | Dimensión | Respuesta ('{score} — {label}') | Tiempo (ms). (3) 'Exportar respuestas CSV' button using exportCsv helper (inline or imported). CSV columns: Nº Pregunta, Texto, Dimensión, Respuesta (valor), Respuesta (etiqueta), Tiempo (ms). UTF-8 BOM. (4) Close button at top-right. (5) Click-outside handler (mousedown on overlay). All labels in Spanish.

In ReportsClient.tsx: Add optional staffToken prop to the ReportsClient component signature: { sessions, cohorts, staffToken }: { sessions: SessionSummary[]; cohorts: CohortGroup[]; staffToken?: string | null }. Pass staffToken down to UsuarioTab and GrupoTab.

In ReportsClient.tsx UsuarioTab: Add 'Ver respuestas' button in each table row (after existing 'Ver' link). On click: set selectedSession state, render <SessionDetailModal session={selectedSession} onClose={() => setSelectedSession(null)} staffToken={staffToken} />. Import SessionDetailModal.

In ReportsClient.tsx GrupoTab: Add second export button 'Exportar documento completo' next to existing 'Exportar CSV'. On click: show loading indicator ('Cargando respuestas...'). For each session in filtered, fetch GET /api/sessions/{id}/responses with x-staff-token header. Assemble a flat CSV where each response row includes: Estudiante, Correo, Teléfono, Grupo, Método, Código Dominante, Carrera Top, Fecha, Fiabilidad, Estado, Nº Pregunta, Texto Pregunta, Dimensión, Respuesta Valor, Respuesta Etiqueta, Tiempo (ms). If a session has no responses, include one row with empty response columns. Filename: 'reporte-completo-{grupo}-{date}.csv'. Use the same question bank + scale lookup maps (import them from SessionDetailModal.tsx or define them once at the top of ReportsClient.tsx).

In AdminClient.tsx: Update the ReportsClient call at line ~934 to pass staffToken. In AdminClient, the staffToken comes from STAFF_ACCESS_TOKEN env or null. Since AdminClient is 'use client', it cannot read process.env directly. Instead: add an optional staffToken prop to AdminClient ({ ..., staffToken?: string | null }) and pass it through. In web/app/admin/page.tsx (server component): read process.env.STAFF_ACCESS_TOKEN ?? null and pass as prop to AdminClient. AdminClient then passes it to ReportsClient. Note: this env read is in a server component and is always safe (no module-load-time risk).
acceptance_criteria: web/components/SessionDetailModal.tsx exists and renders a modal with session info + responses table + export button
Clicking 'Ver respuestas' in UsuarioTab opens the modal with that session's responses
Modal shows loading state ('Cargando respuestas...') while fetching
Modal has a close button and click-outside-to-close
Modal shows question text (from question bank lookup), dimension, score with label, and time
'Exportar respuestas CSV' in modal exports UTF-8 BOM CSV with correct columns
GrupoTab has 'Exportar documento completo' button that shows loading state then downloads flat CSV with all sessions x responses

Group CSV includes header: Estudiante, Correo, Teléfono, Grupo, Método, Código Dominante, Carrera Top, Fecha, Fiabilidad, Estado, Nº Pregunta, Texto Pregunta, Dimensión, Respuesta Valor, Respuesta Etiqueta, Tiempo (ms)
Sessions with no responses get one row with empty response columns in group export
staffToken is threaded from admin/page.tsx -> AdminClient -> ReportsClient -> modal/group export
tsc --noEmit passes with no type errors
npm run build passes without env vars
findings: Implemented successfully. ALL_QUESTION_BANKS and ALL_SCALE_LABELS are exported from SessionDetailModal.tsx and imported in ReportsClient.tsx. SessionResponse type import added to ReportsClient. staffToken threaded from server component admin/page.tsx through AdminClient to ReportsClient and down to both UsuarioTab (modal) and GrupoTab (full export). All verification steps passed: tsc --noEmit, lint, 156 tests, and build.
